Experience the charm of a 1930's craftsman style home thoughtfully blended with modern upgrades for a cozy feel. This single-level home welcomes you with a covered front porch perfect for slow mornings with a good book and your favorite coffee. The side yard offers an entertaining space amidst your low maintenance landscaped yard with new fencing, new pavers, and artificial turf all under Sonoma County's mild Mediterranean climate. Inside you'll find 3 bedrooms, office, kitchen and dining area, living room, family room, laundry room, and a mudroom. The beautifully updated kitchen boasts new white cabinets, Taj Mahal quartzite counters and slab backsplash, stainless steel appliances, deep pantry cabinets recessed lighting and an original California Cooler for keeping perishables fresh. Additional features include 9 foot ceilings, brick fireplace, built-in bookshelves, stylish wainscoting, sweet built-in window seat, new water heater, cabinetry for hidden storage throughout the home, shed, and raised garden beds on the side yard. Mature plantings include a tangerine tree, Crepe Myrtle, Lavender, Geranium, Japanese maple, Hibiscus, Roses, Flowering pear, Magnolia & more. The 2-car garage includes the bonus room, workbench with cabinetry, and pull down ladder to access abundant storage in the attic area. The 7,680 sq ft lot provides an abundance of parking.
